Row.Text: "Perhaps for the first time in their history, the Japanese people came to understand what was meant by the State."
"Our tears are not the dew, but have become a sea in the center of our circle."
"Heian-kyō’s planners started not with the master grid plan but rather with the single unit."
"Real things in the dark seem no more real than dreams."
